paragraphs.text: This quarter presents a cluster of critical unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities in foundational infrastructure components including NGINX HTTP/2, Apache Roller, Java runtime affecting Jira Jenkins Keycloak, and database engines, with several under active exploitation and added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Control owners must verify asset exposure and remediation status across these pervasive technologies.

A confirmed breach of the N-able Mail Assure and Spam Experts Hosted Cloud demonstrates third-party email security management disruption, while PHP maintainers have announced critical fixes for all supported versions. Supplier assurance and runtime patching processes require immediate validation.
